thread:
support-tilly: :rotating_light: Customer aar-12 reporting intermittent 504s and API timeouts during a tenant burst. Started ~17:04 UTC, affects hosted inference endpoints. They see long queue times then gateway 5xxs.
Maria (SRE): Can you paste a sample request id and timestamps? any client-side retries? :eyes:
support-tilly: request id = req_0a9f3c, seen at 2026-03-17T17:04:12Z. Customer says normal token usage, no spike in model latency reported from client. Retries stack up and then gateway returns 504 after ~12s.
ops-bot: alert: autoscale-latency-spike for cluster infer-prod-3 — queueDepth > 120 for 30s, gateway 5xx rate increased by 19%.
jax (runtime): quick look — model pods show normal inference p95 ~200ms. Problem looks like scale-up lag + socket queueing on the gateway layer. KEDA metrics for that scaledobject show no metric pull during the window (auth 401 to metrics-api).
kevin (platform): that's interesting — last deploy rolled an updated metrics provider secret rotation. If KEDA can't scrape metrics, HPA won't trigger scale. Seems like an auth mismatch between keda-metrics-svc and metrics exporter.
sre-eli: can we get the KEDA logs for the scaledobject for tenant aar-12? also paste the scaledobject YAML.
jax (runtime): logs snippet:
```
I0317 17:03:56.123 keda-controller: failed to fetch metric: unauthorized (401) token expired
I0317 17:04:05.987 keda-controller: no activation: metric provider error
```
scaledobject excerpt:
```
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: so-tenant-aar-12
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    deploymentName: infer-tenant-aar-12
  triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata:
      serverAddress: http://keda-metrics.svc:9090
      metricName: http_requests_inflight
      query: sum(rate(http_requests_inflight{tenant="aar-12"}[30s]))
      threshold: "20"
```
jax (runtime): note — the scaledobject uses the cluster-wide metrics endpoint which now requires bearer token; previously we had a service account token mounted. After secret rotation the token mount path changed.
Maria (SRE): so KEDA never saw the inflight metric -> no scale-up -> gateway queue saturates -> 504s. Root cause likely metrics auth + readiness/warmup also slow.
kevin (platform): confirmed: secret keda-metrics-sa-token-xy no longer present in keda-metrics namespace after rotation. Ops play: restore token or fallback to HPA based on CPU while we fix metrics auth.
sre-eli: mitigation plan?
Maria (SRE): immediate mitigation: 1) increase minReplicas for infer-tenant-aar-12 to 2 (patch HPA) 2) re-create the keda serviceaccount token secret from backup 3) temporarily reduce gateway request timeout to 10s to fail fast and avoid head-of-line blocking for other tenants.
jax (runtime): repro steps for local testing:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <cust-token>" -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"x"}' -v -o /dev/null
2) simulate multiple concurrent requests: for i in {1..200}; do curl -s ... & done
3) watch `kubectl get hpa,scaledobject --namespace=tenant-aar-12` and `kubectl logs -l app=keda -n keda`.
support-tilly: customer is asking for ETA on fix — can we give something quick?
kevin (platform): if we restore token now we should see KEDA resume metric pulls within 30-60s and scale, full recovery ~3-5 minutes. Patch to HPA minReplicas takes effect immediately but pods still need container start (~20-40s) depending on GPU init.
Maria (SRE): action items: @kevin restore keda token + confirm metric pulls; @jax prepare a shortrun patch to HPA minReplicas for critical tenants; @sre-eli follow up with customer with mitigation ETA.
sre-eli: I'll message the customer with the 5-10 minute window and advise them to avoid burst retries for now. Also capturing repro and logs for postmortem.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: patch/hpa-minreplicas -> infer-tenant-aar-12 (rolling) by jax at 17:05:23Z
kevin (platform): token restored and KEDA logs now show pulls: `I0317 17:05:41.002 keda-controller: fetched metric ok` — scaling event triggered.
ops-bot: recovery: queueDepth dropped below 20 at 17:08:02Z, gateway 5xx back to baseline.
Maria (SRE): closing loop — root cause = metrics auth break after secret rotation + tight HPA minReplica=0 + slow pod warmstart for some models. Postmortem items: automate token rotation sync, add fallback HPA trigger (cpu) for activation, and add a warmstart prewarm pool for high-tenancy customers.
support-tilly: noted, customer updated, they saw requests recover. Thanks team :thumbsup:
sre-eli: will open a ticket and assign follow-ups.
Maria (SRE): will add runbook steps for immediate mitigation (restore token, patch minReplicas).
